headline: Small short-period S junk with cross wind — marginal at best.
today: Only 1.5ft at 3-4s, so it's soft and gutless despite the decent angle. Wind stays cross most of the day and doesn't help. Log the dawn if you're desperate, otherwise wait it out.

daysToWatch.note: Tiny but clean — offshore dawn with a good angle, longboard-only glass before the SSE onshore arrives midday.
20-plus mph onshore all day — blown out, skip it.
The week's standout: 2-3ft on a good angle with light NW cross-off through the morning. Best window is early before the SW cross-on builds in the afternoon — shortboard or fish.
